{{Quote|«I was once the premier information broker with the Shroud's syndicate, until&hellip; Let us just say, my superiors and I had differing opinions about the direction of the organization. After I left, I continued to serve many high-profile clients&mdash;but on my terms. I only choose to work with those who seek to bring something better to the galaxy.»|Altuur zok Adon introduces himself to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="TORcite">{{TORcite|type=general|exp=ons|The Stranger from Kubindi|Odessen}}</ref>|quotestart=0|trans=1}}
'''Altuur zok Adon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] information broker and [[Sniper/Legends|marksman]] who left [[the Shroud's syndicate]] and offered his services to the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Task Force Nova]]<ref name="TORcite" /> in early [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}</ref> While Adon was the premier information broker under [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s employ, the Kubaz had disagreements with his superiors and thus parted ways. Altuur zok Adon then decided to assist the Alliance Commander as he was amazed by tales of the Commander's journey. Claiming that no one across a hundred [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] could match his skills, the Kubaz promoted himself as an experienced broker of sensitive intelligence and an superb marksman. When they first met on [[Odessen]], Adon expressed his great pleasure in meeting the Alliance Commander, declaring it to be a profoundly momentous occasion.<ref name="TORcite" />

Adon was a Kubaz with pale [[Color/Legends|brown]] hair who wore brown [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], a gray belt, and a pair of red [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]]. He was a stranger from [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]] to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TORweb" />

==Behind the scenes==
Altuur zok Adon was introduced as a companion in the [[2021]] Update 6.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', a digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Adon is to be obtainable as a companion by players as a reward for participating in the Galactic Seasons event.<ref name="TORweb" />
